biomarkers.name: ETP immunophenotype (CD5 dim, CD1a-, CD8-, ≥1 myeloid marker+)
FLT3, NRAS/KRAS, JAK, DNMT3A, IDH1/2 mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports the characteristic stem cell/myeloid-like biology of ETP-ALL; does not by itself establish indication for AML-directed therapy

biomarkers.name: NOTCH1 mutations
biomarkers.prevalence: Generally less frequent than in typical non-ETP T-ALL
biomarkers.clinical_use: Helps distinguish biology from typical T-ALL

biomarkers.name: Venetoclax response
biomarkers.clinical_use: ETP-ALL often shows relative BCL2 dependence in preclinical/translational studies; venetoclax-based combinations are under clinical investigation, not an established validated predictive biomarker

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Immature lymphoblasts with T-cell lineage assignment but incomplete T-cell differentiation and expression of ≥1 myeloid marker
variants: classic ETP-ALL (CD5 dim, CD1a-, CD8-, ≥1 myeloid marker+)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Not graded; historically considered high-risk/adverse-risk, though prognosis is influenced by treatment era and MRD response

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Biology overlaps partly with stem cell/myeloid programs, but ETP-ALL is treated within ALL paradigms in most contemporary protocols; venetoclax-based approaches remain investigational

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Early thymic/immature T-cell precursor arrested at a very early developmental stage, with retention of stem cell/myeloid features
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm — hematopoietic lymphoid lineage (immature T-lineage precursor with retained stem/myeloid features)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Early T-cell precursor phenotype: CD5 dim, CD1a-, CD8-, with expression of ≥1 myeloid/stem cell marker (for example CD117, CD34, HLA-DR, CD13, CD33, CD11b, or CD65) — bridging phenotype between T-ALL and myeloid/stem-cell programs
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Reflects biology of an early thymic progenitor with retained multilineage/stem-cell features; molecular landscape shows overlap with stem cell/myeloid neoplasia more than typical mature T-ALL, including enrichment of FLT3, RAS-pathway, JAK/IL7R-pathway, DNMT3A, EZH2, RUNX1, and occasionally IDH1/2 alterations
